label: Sfx: Bramblesnare's cast, crackle, snare and bite arms, replacing the freeze's creak and cinch
why: The four voices of v84 s4, in the synth only; there is no close voice. The row REPLACES the four lines of the freeze's 'creak and cinch' -- the arm keyed on this relic, which v84 retires with the freeze -- and adds the crackle's, the snare's and the bite's arms beside it; it does not touch the shared rune-crack fallback. The snare's body is Tendril's root arm's, transcribed (not on this base; equal to Tendril's own to 9e-08). Through the patched play() every arm reproduces its lab candidate (worst 4e-07, on two noise draws), 138 other voices are unchanged (worst 1e-07), ult/thornwake is no longer the old arm and the bare fallback is still rune-crack. play() returns on its first line with no audio context (every headless run), draws no random number and writes nothing the simulation reads; end to end the four voices through the patched page's own SFX.play equal the candidates (worst 9e-08).

label: tickBramble: the bite's soft snap, once per bite, as the thorns' cooldown is re-armed
code:

             snap per bite, on the bite's own step, as the thorns' cooldown is
             re-armed -- the line every bite starts with -- ahead of its
             entangle and its hurt on the same step. A killing bite snaps too
             (the number of snaps is the number of bites); its fatal beat is
